name: ElevenLabs Skills
summary: Official ElevenLabs Agent Skills for speech, voice, music, dubbing and agents. MIT pack; calling ElevenLabs APIs needs an API key and is billed separately.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (ElevenLabs). The elevenlabs/skills repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2024 ElevenLabs), not archived. The pack is free to install; the README says all skills require an ElevenLabs API key in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, and calling ElevenLabs APIs is paid under ElevenLabs billing. Refund terms for that API were not re-verified here. No key was created and no spend was made. This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. Documented install is `npx skills add elevenlabs/skills` (not run). Twelve skills: text-to-speech, speech-to-text, speech-engine, realtime, agents, sound-effects, music, voice-changer, voice-isolator, dubbing, onboarding and setup-api-key. The README warns to use the JavaScript SDK `@elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js` and not `npm install elevenlabs` (an outdated v1.x package). Python examples use `pip install elevenlabs`; a CLI is documented as `npm install -g @elevenlabs/cli` or `brew install elevenlabs/tap/elevenlabs`. Those installs were not run. The onboarding skill is documented to write an API key into a project env file; that skill was not executed. Related conversational-agent product: elevenagents.

agent_access.notes: Public MIT pack. Documented `npx skills add elevenlabs/skills` was not executed. The README says skills require ELEVENLABS_API_KEY to call ElevenLabs APIs, which are billed separately; no key or spend was used. Do not npm-install the outdated `elevenlabs` JS package; use `@elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js`.
